lines.text: Sarah lived to be 127 years old and died in Kiriath-arba, which is Hebron, in Canaan.
Abraham got up from beside his dead wife and asked the Hittites for a burial site.
Abraham asked the Hittites to approach Ephron son of Zohar about selling him the cave of Machpelah.
Abraham weighed out four hundred shekels of silver, according to the standard of the merchants.
Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave of the field at Machpelah near Mamre.
